description: Element-complement duality preserves and reflects inclusion of Boolean filters and ideals.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.duality_preserves_inclusion.{u} {B : Type u} [BooleanAlgebra B]
  (F G : Order.PFilter B) (I J : Order.Ideal B) :
  (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.dualIdeal F ⊆ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.dualIdeal G ↔ F ≤ G) ∧
    (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.dualFilter I ⊆ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.dualFilter J ↔ I ≤ J)
